descriptionPlain:
About us
Acme Robotics builds autonomous mobile robots for warehouses in Asia and Europe. Our software team runs the fleet platform that keeps every robot connected.

The Data Ingestion team moves telemetry from thousands of robots into our platform every second.

lists.content:
• Design, build, and operate Go services that ingest robot telemetry.
  • Run Kafka consumers with clear retry and dead-letter handling.
  • Keep PostgreSQL schemas fast for time-series queries.
